test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following classical dance forms was initiated by Srimant Shankardev, a Vaishnava saint?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sattriya was created by the 15th-16th century polymath Sankardev as part of** Bhaona**, a performance of one-act plays called** Ankiya Nat. **
 
• The dance was originally performed in Sattras, monasteries in Assam, as an **offering to Krishna.**
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi recognized **Sattriya as a classical dance in 2000.**
 
• **Shankardev** is considered the** father of Assamese culture.**
 
 
• He created the dance form to spread the **Vaishnava faith.**
 
• He composed a collection of devotional songs known as **Kirtan Ghosha.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form that originated in **northern India** and is characterized by intricate footwork and precise rhythmic patterns.
 
• **Famous Kathak Dancers Who Revolutionized the Art Form**:-
 
 
• Siddhendra Yogi
 
• Bhai Champa Lal
 
• Maharaja Chakradhar Singh
 
• Shambhu Maharaj
 
• Sitara Devi
 
• Birju Maharaj
 
• Kumudini Lakhia
 
 
 
• **Manipuri** dance is a major classical Indian dance form that originated in the state of **Manipur.**
 
• **Famous Manipuri Dancers Who Revolutionized the Art Form:-**
 
 
• Guru Bipin Singh
 
• Jhaveri sisters: Nayana, Ranjana, Suverna, and Darshana 
 
• Elam Endira Devi 
 
• Yumlembam Gambhini Devi 
 
• Nirmala Mehta 
 
• Charu Mathur
 
• Devyani Chalia
 
 
 
• **Odissi** is a classical Indian dance form that originated in the temples of Odisha, a state in **eastern India.**
 
• **Famous Odissi Dancers Who Revolutionized the Art Form:-**
 
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra
 
• Sanjukta Panigrahi
 
• Sonal Mansingh
 
• Kumkum Mohanty
 
• Guru Mayadhar Raut
 
• Deba Prasad Das
 
• Raghunath Dutta
